description: This file defines and registers commands for a VSCode extension related to the 'Kilo Code' webview, including panel management, command registration, and external integrations.

classes.name: RegisterCommandOptions
classes.description: Type defining options for registering commands, including context, output channel, and provider.

classes.name: AgentManagerProvider
classes.description: Class managing agent-related functionalities within the extension.

classes.name: ClineProvider
classes.description: Class representing the webview provider for the Kilo Code interface.

methods.name: getVisibleProviderOrLog
methods.description: Retrieves the visible ClineProvider instance or logs if none are visible.

methods.name: getPanel
methods.description: Returns the current active webview panel or view.

methods.name: setPanel
methods.description: Sets the current panel reference based on type (sidebar or tab).

methods.name: registerCommands
methods.description: Registers extension commands and initializes agent manager.

methods.name: getCommandsMap
methods.description: Creates a map of command IDs to their callback functions.

methods.name: openClineInNewTab
methods.description: Opens the Kilo Code interface in a new webview tab, managing panel creation and focus.
